newsitem.title: CANADA: Canadian dollar closes weaker on year-end trading.
newsitem.headline: Canadian dollar closes weaker on year-end trading.

text.p: * The Canadian dollar closed weaker at C$1.3695 (0.7302) from Friday's close at C$1.3677 (US$0.7312) in quiet, year-end trading, dealers said.
* They said there was a slight bias to sell the Canadian currency as market players settle their accounts for the end of the year.
Trading on Tuesday, the last day of the year, is difficult to predict, dealers said.
"It could be one of those days when nothing at all happens or all hell breaks loose" if a company decides at the last minute to repatriate profits, one dealer said.
On the crosses, the Canadian dollar weakened to 1.1344 marks from 1.1364 marks on Friday but rose to 84.71 yen from last week's close of 84.30 yen.
